newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bangkok seen as best Asia regional office location.
newsitem.headline: Bangkok seen as best Asia regional office location.

text.p: Property consultant Richard Ellis said on Thursday that Bangkok was still the best value as a location for offices in the Asia region.

"Bangkok, with much improved infrastructure and new grade A stock in all major office locations, makes the city the best deal for regional multinationals," said James Pitchon, director of the company.

Three other Asian cities including Bombay, Hong Kong and the inner central part of Tokyo occupied first, second and third places in the table of most expensive cities, with total costs of $1,691, $1,324 and $1,237 per sq/year respectively, the company said.
It said office market rental performance had been varied in Asia over the past six months.

As a result of consistent demand and restricted supply, rents have risen in New Delhi, Tokyo (outer central), Taipei and Manila, but rising supply and moderate demand has caused them to fall in Singapore, it added.
Prime rental levels have fallen in Bangkok, where property market problems are linked to wider banking and foreign exchange difficulties, the company said.
The Thai property sector has been depressed by a glut and high interest rates that have discouraged loan taking and depressed demand leading to a glut.
